title: Reflection groups on smooth projective threefolds
summary: Let $Y$ be a smooth projective threefold with $H^2(Y, \mathcal{O}_Y)=0$ and unobstructed deformations. We define reflection groups $W_Y^{sm}$ and $W_Y^{big}$ canonically associated to $Y$, acting on the nef, resp. movable cone of a very general deformation of $Y$. If $-K_Y$ is nef, we show that $\mathrm{Nef}(Y)\cap\mathrm{Big}(Y)$ (resp. $\overline{\mathrm{Mov}}(Y)\cap\mathrm{Big}(Y)$) is a fundamental domain for the action of the corresponding group on the big part of the generic cone.
